name: application-logo-cloud-grid
title: Logo Cloud Grid
description: Customer/partner logo cloud: a heading above a grid of monochrome logos separated by subtle interior dividers rather than gapped cards.
useWhen: Showing a row or grid of customer/partner company logos as social proof on a marketing or pricing page.
You want a cohesive bordered grid with dividers between cells instead of individually spaced logo cards.
Distinct from Amenities Grid, which lists icon+label facility features, rather than external brand/company logos as social proof.
avoidWhen: Listing facility or product features with icons and labels — use Amenities Grid instead.
Only a couple of logos need to be shown — a simple inline row is simpler than a bordered grid.
responsiveBehavior: The grid steps from 3 columns on narrow viewports to 4 columns at the sm breakpoint; divide-x/divide-y keeps interior borders consistent regardless of column count.
accessibility: Each logo SVG carries an aria-label naming the company, since the mark alone (shape + wordmark) may not be recognizable to assistive tech.
Logos render in a single desaturated color so brand recognition doesn't rely on color alone.

variants.title: Logo Cloud Grid
variants.description: An 8-logo grid of stylized monochrome company marks with a 'Trusted by teams at' heading.
accessibility: Each logo SVG carries an aria-label naming the company.

variants.title: Logo Cloud Grid (Dark)
variants.description: The same logo grid adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Logo and divider contrast remain distinguishable at dark-surface contrast.
